epoch.description: Read-owner incarnation; compare sequence only within this epoch.

sequence.description: Allocated before synchronous projection. A later snapshot always has a greater sequence.

anyOf.description: User-visible thread folder name.

folder.description: Optional sidebar folder; null means ungrouped.

repoRoot.description: Project root the thread is anchored to; null for a no-project thread.

workspaceMode.description: Per-thread workspace mode: in_place mutates the live project tree directly (the default); isolated keeps a persistent git worktree per thread that apply merges into the project; delegated runs every turn in one caller-owned workspace bound at creation, which Claudexor never applies to the project or deletes.

workspaceRoot.description: Caller-owned workspace a delegated thread executes in; null for in_place and isolated threads.

authPreference.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

primaryHarness.description: Sticky primary harness for the thread; null = engine routing.

eligibleHarnesses.description: Sticky eligible harness pool; empty = the engine auto-pools.

anyOf.description: Non-empty identifier string.

credentialProfileId.description: Sticky credential profile for the thread; per-turn selection wins, null = engine-default credentials.

anyOf.description: Access profile recorded by an immutable historical artifact. external_sandbox_full is retired and cannot be requested by active surfaces.

access.description: Sticky write scope for write turns; null = the repo trust default.

state.description: Thread lifecycle state: active, closed, trashed for recovery, or terminally purged.

headRunId.description: Most recent run of the thread; null before the first turn runs.

needsHuman.description: True when the head turn is blocked on a human decision (needs-me inbox).

updatedAt.description: When the thread was last updated.

thread.description: Control-plane projection of a thread (camelCase view of the Thread artifact).

latestOrdinal.description: Latest stored turn ordinal, including runless turns; null only for an empty thread.

runId.description: Run backing this turn; null while unbound.

code.description: Machine-readable refusal code; remedies key on it, never on the message text.

retryable.description: False when no recorded job exists to replay — surfaces offer a new message instead of a doomed retry.

requiredActions.description: Bounded user actions that may make an exact retry succeed.

context.description: Bounded typed recovery context for exact retry.

enqueueError.description: Why this turn has no run (enqueue/preflight refusal); null once a run binds.

anyOf.description: Control-plane run state = the run LIFECYCLE (D8): queued/running while live, then exactly one of succeeded / failed / cancelled / interrupted. Outcome quality (checks/review/delivery) is orthogonal — see outcomeFacts.

state.description: Control-plane run state = the run LIFECYCLE (D8): queued/running while live, then exactly one of succeeded / failed / cancelled / interrupted. Outcome quality (checks/review/delivery) is orthogonal — see outcomeFacts.

anyOf.description: Control-plane projection of one thread turn with its embedded run card.

latestAdmission.description: Control-plane projection of one thread turn with its embedded run card.

mode.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

strategy.description: Engine strategy flag on the mode, when any.

n.description: Race width, when the run was a race.

kind.description: What the turn actually produced: a Git patch, directory files, an answer, a plan, a report, or nothing.

diffStat.description: Diff statistics; null unless a patch exists.

blockers.description: Count of accepted blocking review findings.

adopted.description: True when the live in-place tree was mutated this turn (regardless of review); null when unknown.

applyState.description: Honest application state: not_applied (delivery pending), applied, applied_review_blocked, reverted, or discarded (remaining copied output deliberately not applied).

preTurnSha.description: Tree SHA before this turn mutated the in-place tree (revert restore target).

postTurnSha.description: Tree SHA right after this turn's mutation; revert refuses if the working tree has diverged from this since.

revertable.description: Revert metadata is available so a Revert affordance may be offered; not a live-safe guarantee — the server re-checks tree divergence at revert time.

result.description: Honest terminal outcome of a run (what the turn actually did), projected from the work product and answer artifacts.

noChanges.description: True when the run finished without changing any files (the ex no_op fact).

checks.description: Deterministic checks axis: configured project checks passed, failed, or none are configured (a named state, never a stand-in for review results).

review.description: Review axis: approved (clean cross-family verified review), blocked (open accepted findings), or not_run.

review_requested.description: Frozen model-review intent. False permits an honestly unreviewed result; absent historical records retain the review requirement.

anyOf.description: Typed reason qualifying a non-clean terminal; null on a clean success.

reason.description: Typed reason qualifying a non-clean terminal; null on a clean success.

state.description: Folded work state: the WorkReport state, or unverified when no valid report was obtained (transport unsupported / lane gated, or an instructed footer missing or broken).

source.description: Provenance of a WorkReport: constrained (native schema transport), validated (instructed terminal metadata), or absent (no transport could carry one — a disclosed absence, not a failure).

kind.description: Category of a missing input a needs_input/incomplete report lists: a file, additional context, a credential, a permission, a human decision, or an external dependency.

locator.description: Concrete pointer to the missing thing (path/url/name); null when unnameable.

description.description: Human-readable description of what is needed and why.

items.description: One blocking input a needs_input/incomplete WorkReport lists.

required_inputs.description: Carried through from a needs_input/incomplete WorkReport for honest disclosure.

unverified_reason.description: Present only with state unverified on a validated (instructed footer) source: the disclosed cause of the missing report.

work_state.description: D-16 model-attested work outcome, orthogonal to lifecycle; a needs_input/incomplete state vetoes applyability and exit 0. Absent on runs with no work_report transport.

anyOf.description: Independent terminal outcome axes of a run (D8/D18).

outcomeFacts.description: D8 terminal outcome axes (checks/review/reason/noChanges) for the turn; null while non-terminal.

spendUsd.description: Settled cash in USD; null when unknown.

outputReadyState.description: Whether a terminal run also has a loaded user-facing output artifact: pending (not yet), finalizing (being produced), ready (loaded), diagnostic (only diagnostic output).

waitingOnUser.description: True while an interactive question is awaiting the user's answer.

finishedAt.description: When the run finished; null while live.

anyOf.description: Engine-owned Delegate requested/effective/used receipt; surfaces project it without parsing model output.

delegation.description: Durable Delegate outcome receipt; null for ordinary and legacy turns.

delegatedChildRunIds.description: At most eight server-owned direct Delegate child ids for whole-thread workspace aggregation.

run.description: Compact run state embedded on a turn so a chat surface renders the whole conversation from one thread fetch.

harnessId.description: Harness the session is bound to.

nativeSessionId.description: The vendor CLI session id; null when none exists.

observedModel.description: Model last observed on the session's stream.

profileId.description: Credential profile the vendor session was created under; resume never crosses profiles (null = engine-default credentials).

state.description: Session cache state: live, stale, or rebound.

items.description: Control-plane projection of a vendor CLI session bound to a thread.

parentRunId.description: Run this turn follows up on, when any.

answersPlanRunId.description: Plan run whose open questions this follow-up turn answers.

planRunId.description: Set when this turn implements an approved plan from an earlier run.

planHash.description: SHA-256 of the frozen plan bytes this Implement turn materialized (INV-081); null on non-Implement/legacy turns (QA-046).

planReadinessOverridden.description: True when the operator implemented a not-ready plan over open questions (INV-081); recorded for provenance, rendered on the card (QA-046).

kind.description: Kind of thread turn: the initial message, a followup, or an operator decision turn.

prompt.description: The user's message for this turn.

kind.description: How a turn's lane was continued: native_resume (the lane's own vendor session already held the delta), packet (a continuation packet hydrated a lane switch/gap), or fresh (nothing to carry — the thread's first turn on any lane).

packetTurns.description: Delta turns carried in the continuation packet (0 for native_resume/fresh).

summarized.description: True when the packet collapsed an older prefix (mechanical fallback).

harness.description: Harness of the lane switched away from.

profileId.description: Profile of the lane switched away from (null = engine default).

laneSwitchedFrom.description: The lane this turn switched away from; null for an in-lane continuation.

continuity.description: How this turn's lane was continued (native resume / packet / fresh); null until stamped.

totalTextBytes.description: Complete UTF-8 length, only when known; never an estimated remainder.

anyOf.description: Auth mode a route runs under: a native local session, an API key, or unknown.

effective.description: Auth mode a route runs under: a native local session, an API key, or unknown.

anyOf.description: Concrete credential source used or probed by a harness.

source.description: Concrete credential source used or probed by a harness.

reason.description: Deterministic reason for the effective auth route: as_requested, native_first (auto, INV-061), no_native_session_fallback (auto downgraded to api_key), requested_route_unavailable (explicit preference contradicted), or undisclosed.

profileId.description: Credential profile the deciding attempt ran under; null = engine-default credentials.

modelMismatch.description: Requested-vs-observed model mismatch; null when none.

authRoute.description: Auth route receipt (requested/effective/source/reason + disclosing attempt), projected verbatim from telemetry; null when unavailable.

spendEstimated.description: True when settled cash is estimated rather than exact.

observedModel.description: Model the harness stream actually reported.

harnessId.description: Harness that ran the final attempt.

verified.description: True only when an observed model was actually reported by the harness stream — never inferred from the request.

anyOf.description: Run-level route evidence projected from telemetry (requested vs observed model).

route.description: Route evidence from telemetry; null when no telemetry exists (legacy runs).

cashKnowledge.description: Cash certainty from the ledger; explicit unknown keeps spendUsd null independently of valuation.

paidBudget.description: Incremental-cash budget: explicitly unlimited or a finite non-negative USD cap.

spendUsd.description: CASH spend so far in USD; null when unknown.

controllableSpendUsd.description: Cash governed by the finite cap: settled amounts on routes Claudexor controls; null when that cash is unknown. spendUsd can still be null when an included subscription reports no actual debit.

valuationUsd.description: Subscription valuation in USD (separate from billed cash); null when unknown — never a fabricated $0 (QA-023c).

valuationKnowledge.description: Confidence of valuationUsd: 'estimated' when token-derived, 'unknown' when no usage was reported (valuationUsd is then null), 'exact' when natively priced.

remainingUsd.description: Remaining finite cap after controllableSpendUsd; null when no cap or unknown.

estimated.description: True when settled cash is estimated rather than exact; subscription valuation confidence is reported separately.

source.description: Where the snapshot came from: the decision record, live events, settings, or unknown.

evidence.description: Integrity of the canonical events this spend fallback read: 'incomplete' when malformed/non-object event lines were skipped, 'unavailable' when the events file was unreadable, else 'complete'. A non-complete value means the projected spend may disagree with disk truth.

budget.description: Budget snapshot for a run: cap, spend, and provenance.

scope.description: All text input items in one native turn; separate instructions are excluded.

reported_source.description: Redacted credential source the vendor's startup frame reported.

requestRefusal.description: Vendor-attested request refusal that stops retries and account rotation on its harness; input, executable and credential-source causes carry their own evidence.

packet_tokens.description: The packet with every optional file omitted: mandatory files, file manifest and metadata.

framing_tokens.description: The request outside the packet: instructions, user text, patch protocol and attachments.

output_allowance_tokens.description: Tokens kept free for the answer.

estimated_tokens.description: This file's share of packet_tokens: its packet entry with content and evidence.

rawContextShortfall.description: Typed sizes behind code raw_context_exceeds_window: the window, the request's parts and every mandatory file, so surfaces never read them from safeMessage.

phase.description: Pipeline phase where the failure happened.

category.description: Typed failure category (validation, project, auth, harness, config, budget, policy, cancelled, internal, unknown). config_error is a settings/routing misconfiguration (e.g. quality routing with no comparable tier), corrected by changing configuration, not by re-auth or waiting for a harness.

anyOf.description: Machine-readable failure sub-code within a RunFailure category, including historical delegated-run failures and active access-profile refusals.

code.description: Machine-readable failure sub-code within the category; null when the category alone is sufficient. Surfaces choose remediation from this, never by parsing safeMessage.

harnessId.description: Harness involved in the failure, when known.

attemptId.description: Attempt involved in the failure, when known.

rawDetailRef.description: Artifact path holding the raw (redacted) failure detail.

logRefs.description: Log artifact paths relevant to the failure.

eventRefs.description: Event references relevant to the failure.

resetsAt.description: When the refused window reopens (a spent subscription quota window), or null when the failure has no such time. Callers schedule a retry off this field, never off safeMessage.

basis.description: owner_reserve: usage reached the saved headroom_threshold below 100% while the provider reports quota left; provider_window: the provider reports the window spent; provider_cooldown: a provider rate-limit cooldown is in force.

constraintId.description: The refusing quota window, when known.

threshold.description: The headroom_threshold the decision applied, when it applied one.

quotaRefusal.description: Present when quota admission refused the account (code subscription_window_exhausted): separates the owner's saved reserve from provider exhaustion. Absent on other failures and on records written before this field existed.

code.description: The vendor's own machine-readable failure code, verbatim; null when the vendor recorded an error without one.

message.description: The vendor's own words from the same record, verbatim (redacted); null when absent.

source.description: Evidence channel the code was read from (codex: `codex_rollout`). An open vocabulary: consumers display it, never branch on it.

anyOf.description: Vendor-typed failure evidence read from a vendor-owned machine-readable record, never parsed from prose.

vendorFailure.description: The vendor's own typed failure for the attempt this record speaks for, or null when no vendor-typed evidence exists (every harness without such a channel, and any unreadable record). Facts only: carries no remedy.

profileId.description: Account row the try ran on; null = the harness default route.

profileDisplayName.description: The row's display name at try time (redacted); null for the default route.

requestedModel.description: Model the try asked for; null = the harness default model.

tryIndex.description: Zero-based try index within the attempt.

observedAt.description: When the try's first error was observed.

phase.description: How far the try got: before a typed session start, after start but before agent progress, or after progress.

category.description: Typed failure category of the try; untyped errors are unknown_harness_error.

error.description: The try's own error text with its original wording and whitespace, redacted.

vendorFailure.description: The vendor's own typed failure for this try, when the adapter attached one.

items.description: Per-try account attribution of a failed execution try (diagnostic evidence only).

poolAttempts.description: Every failed execution try in order, each with its own account and error text; empty when no try failed (and for records written before this field existed).

anyOf.description: Typed failure record for a run: phase, category, evidence references, and suggested next actions.

failure.description: Typed failure info; null unless the run failed.

eligible.description: True when the apply gate would accept this run's patch right now.

state.description: The gate's apply-eligibility classification (e.g. needs_review | not_verified | no_changes | ok) when known.

reason.description: The gate's refusal text when not eligible (null when eligible).

requiredAction.description: Honest guidance for what actually unblocks apply (typed operator decision, add gates, re-run, or nothing to apply).

anyOf.description: Derived apply-gate verdict for a run's WorkProduct (single producer in the delivery gate).

applyEligibility.description: Derived apply-gate verdict (single producer: the delivery gate); null when the run has no patch artifact.

id.description: Stable machine id for a required operator action on a blocked terminal run.

detail.description: Human-readable guidance for this action (English-only, INV-141).

items.description: One typed required operator action derived from a run's terminal outcome facts.

requiredActions.description: Stable-id required operator actions for a succeeded-but-blocked run (GH #29); empty for clean/decided/failed runs.

state.description: Derived plan readiness: ready (block parsed, zero open questions), needs_answers (open questions remain), unverified (no parseable block — the planner ignored the format).

anyOf.description: Server-derived readiness of a plan run (one derivation owner; D17).

planReadiness.description: Derived readiness of a plan run; null for non-plan runs.

id.description: Stable question id within the plan revision.

kind.description: Question kind: pick exactly one, pick one or more, or free text.

id.description: Stable option id within the question.

label.description: Option label shown to the user.

items.description: One selectable option of a plan question.

options.description: Options for single/multi questions; empty for free text.

allow_text.description: True when free text is accepted as a complete answer, including as an alternative to single/multi options.

items.description: One open question surfaced by a plan revision.

planQuestions.description: Open questions of a plan run (projected from final/questions.json); empty otherwise.

outcomeBanner.description: Server-owned outcome headline (status-projection.outcomeBanner); null while the run is not terminal.

operatorDecision.description: Persisted operator unblock decision (accept_risk/override), hash-bound; null when none was made.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the artifact; bumped on breaking ABI changes.

present.description: Whether the canonical primary deliverable exists.

kind.description: Kind of canonical primary deliverable; null when none exists.

path.description: Run-relative path of the canonical primary deliverable; null when absent.

producer_attempt_id.description: Attempt that produced the deliverable, when known.

deliverable.description: Canonical primary-output presence and identity for a terminal run.

state.description: Terminal output readiness decided by the last valid output.ready receipt.

kind.description: Presentation kind of the terminal primary artifact.

path.description: Normalized run-relative path of the terminal primary artifact.

anyOf.description: Primary user-facing artifact selected once during terminal preparation.

primary.description: Selected terminal primary artifact, or null when the receipt announces readiness without a primary deliverable.

presentation.description: Immutable terminal output state and primary artifact. Absent only on legacy RunFacts receipts.

planners.description: Number of participants whose canonical role is planner.

attempt_id.description: Attempt id when the participant owns an orchestrator attempt; null for reviewer-panel members.

harness_id.description: Harness that served this participant role.

role.description: Canonical role of one participant in the terminal run graph.

deliverable_present.description: Whether this participant produced the deliverable its role requested.

anyOf.description: Terminal outcome recorded for one run participant.

status.description: Participant outcome when recorded; null for artifact-only reviewer membership.

items.description: One role-labelled participant in the terminal run graph.

participants.description: Terminal participant graph plus its planner-lane count.

configured.description: Whether the frozen task configured deterministic gates.

executed.description: Whether the terminal attempt executed the gate set.

state.description: Terminal state of the configured deterministic gate set.

receipt_attempt_id.description: Attempt whose gate receipt decides this projection; null when no gates executed.

gates.description: Canonical gate configuration and terminal receipt projection.

blocker_ids.description: Stable ids of accepted evidence-backed blocking findings.

review.description: Canonical terminal review verdict and blocking-finding identity.

eligibility.description: Delivery-gate eligibility at terminalization; null when nothing is applyable.

operator_decision_present.description: Whether a valid operator decision was present when the receipt was finalized.

apply.description: Terminal apply eligibility and operator-decision state.

required_actions.description: Typed actions required to unblock this terminal outcome.

generated_at.description: When this immutable terminal receipt was finalized.

anyOf.description: Validated immutable terminal facts for one run.

runFacts.description: Validated terminal RunFacts receipt; null while active or unavailable.

unverifiedOperatorDecision.description: Recorded decision whose exact evidence exceeds the history read bound. Never grants authority.

fileCount.description: File-kind tool calls, not distinct paths or the WorkProduct diffstat.

anyOf.description: Compact run state embedded on a turn so a chat surface renders the whole conversation from one thread fetch.

run.description: Compact run state embedded on a turn so a chat surface renders the whole conversation from one thread fetch.

kind.description: What kind of output this is: answer, report, plan, summary, patch, diagnostic, or structured_output (schema-conformant final/output.json).

bytes.description: Size of the output in bytes.

anyOf.description: The run's primary user-facing output artifact.

primaryOutput.description: The run's primary user-facing output artifact.

anyOf.description: Control-plane projection of one thread turn with its embedded run card.

answeredByPrompt.description: Control-plane projection of one thread turn with its embedded run card.

items.description: Control-plane projection of one thread turn with its embedded run card.

replayNextCursor.description: Continue the original replay membership if current facts no longer fit one page; merge every segment before declaring the refresh complete.
